changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries, removed AMR 2.0 test split (it's part of the Four Translations dataset), removed ESCHER (WSD system, not NLG model), and added missing NLG tasks and models mentioned in the paper.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE following simplification guidelines. All other metrics are correctly identified and normalized.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses automatic metrics and mentions a qualitative case study but no LLM evaluation.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on semantic parsing and generation using the BabelNet Meaning Representation (BMR) formalism. It evaluates NLG through three main experiments: Graph-to-Text generation, Text-to-Graph parsing, and Text-to-Graph-to-Text machine translation. The paper uses standard automatic metrics but does not conduct human or LLM-as-judge evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some consolidation and normalization.
